newsitem.title: USA: Sprint Spectrum arranges $5.1 bln financing.
newsitem.headline: Sprint Spectrum arranges $5.1 bln financing.

text.p: Sprint Spectrum LP, which will market personal communications services under the name Sprint PCS, said Thursday it closed three credit agreements providing a total of $5.1 billion in available financing.
Sprint PCS is a partnership of Sprint Corp, Tele-Communications Inc, Cox Communications Inc and Comcast Corp.
The partnership has licenses to provide PCS, an emerging form of wireless telecommunications, in 33 areas of the United States with an aggregate population of 190 million.

Sprint Spectrum said the credit agreements consist of a $2 billion senior secured credit agreement arranged by Chase Manhattan Bank, a $1.8 billion senior secured credit agreement with Lucent Technologies Inc and a $1.3 billion senior secured credit agreement with Northern Telecom Inc.
